Afternoon a few reminders for busy families
With that in mind
Travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways should know that we are here to help make pet travel feel calm, clear, and handled with care.

What to expect at the desk

Our team works through routine travel needs each day, from checking basic details to helping with pet documents and crate guidance. The senior coordinator keeps service choices steady, and trained staff give each animal patient attention so families can feel supported. If you are bringing a pet for a trip, please come prepared with the usual travel papers and any comfort items that help your animal settle in.

We know travel can feel like a lot, especially when you are balancing bags, children, and a companion animal at the same time. That is why we aim to keep the process simple and respectful. If plans change, tell us as soon as you can so we can help you adjust without extra stress. Small updates often make a big difference for both you and your pet, and our staff will do what they can to guide you through the next steps.

If you need help with an upcoming trip, please visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
